response.text: Invoice 230 uses JRNL 1364, which has a 9.00 imbalance, and invoice 705 has a 27.00 liability mismatch in its own journal. I have enough to submit.

findings.evidence_sql: SELECT l."JRNL_NO", SUM(l."DR_AMT") AS dr, SUM(l."CR_AMT") AS cr FROM "GLJRNL" l WHERE l."JRNL_NO"=1364 GROUP BY l."JRNL_NO" HAVING ABS(SUM(l."DR_AMT")-SUM(l."CR_AMT"))>0.001
findings.summary: GL journal 1364 (linked to AP invoice 230, amount 6883.61) is unbalanced: debits 6874.61 vs credits 6883.61, a difference of 9.00.

findings.evidence_sql: SELECT l."JRNL_NO", l."LN_SEQ", l."ACCT_CD", l."DR_AMT" FROM "GLJRNL" l LEFT JOIN "GLCOA" c ON TRIM(c."ACCT_CD")=TRIM(l."ACCT_CD") WHERE c."ACCT_CD" IS NULL
findings.summary: GL journal line in JRNL 2194 posts 4018.13 debit to account 5950, which does not exist in the chart of accounts (GLCOA).

findings.evidence_sql: SELECT i."INV_ID", i."VEND_CD", i."INV_NO", i."INV_AMT", i."JRNL_NO" FROM "APINVH" i WHERE UPPER(REGEXP_REPLACE(TRIM(i."INV_NO"),'[^A-Za-z0-9]','','g')) = 'V000148314465'
findings.summary: AP invoice V0001-48314-465 was entered twice: INV_ID 465 and INV_ID 801 (INV_NO has a trailing space in 801), same vendor V0001, same date and amount 12185.45, posted to separate journals 1746 and 2458.

findings.evidence_sql: SELECT i."INV_ID", i."INV_AMT", SUM(l."CR_AMT") AS ap_cr FROM "APINVH" i JOIN "GLJRNL" l ON l."JRNL_NO"=i."JRNL_NO" AND TRIM(l."ACCT_CD") IN (SELECT TRIM("ACCT_CD") FROM "GLCOA" WHERE "ACCT_TYP"='LIABILITY') GROUP BY i."INV_ID", i."INV_AMT" HAVING SUM(l."CR_AMT")<>i."INV_AMT"
findings.summary: AP invoice 705 (amount 9052.55) is recorded in journal 2147 with 9079.55 credited to liability accounts, a 27.00 difference between the subsidiary invoice and the ledger.

findings.evidence_sql: SELECT i."INV_ID", i."INV_NO", i."INV_AMT", i."JRNL_NO" FROM "APINVH" i WHERE i."INV_AMT"<0
findings.summary: AP invoice 802 (reference V0013-41051-794-CM, a credit memo) is stored with a negative amount of -207.62 and its journal 2461 has no liability credit line, so it does not tie to the AP subledger. Sign convention is undocumented.

findings.evidence_sql: SELECT i."INV_ID", i."INV_AMT", SUM(p."PAY_AMT") AS paid FROM "APINVH" i JOIN "APPAYM" p ON p."INV_ID"=i."INV_ID" GROUP BY i."INV_ID", i."INV_AMT" HAVING SUM(p."PAY_AMT")<>i."INV_AMT"
findings.summary: Invoice 421 (status P, paid) has payments totalling 5248.89 against an invoice amount of 5248.88, a 0.01 overpayment.

findings.evidence_sql: SELECT j."JRNL_NO", j."PRD_ID", j."POST_DT", p."CLOSE_DT" FROM "GLJRNH" j JOIN "GLPERD" p ON p."PRD_ID"=j."PRD_ID" WHERE p."STAT_CD"='C' AND j."POST_DT">p."CLOSE_DT"
findings.summary: Journal 2459 is posted on 20240319 into period 2 (Feb 2024), which was closed on 20240305, i.e. after the period closed.
